title: Neuropeptide reporter assay for serum, capillary blood and blood cards
author: Schreiber, Engl, et al.

steps.title: Collect capillary blood
steps.instruction: Using Drummond Microcaps, collect 1 µL, 3 µL or 5 µL of capillary blood from healthy volunteers (Helsinki declaration) and dispense the blood into a micro‑tube or onto a Whatman 903 Protein Saver Card.

steps.title: Prepare dried blood spots
steps.instruction: If blood is deposited on a card, air‑dry the spot for 1–2 h at room temperature, then store the card at –20 °C until further processing.

steps.title: Extract blood or spot
steps.instruction: Add HEPES‑buffer (50 mM HEPES, 300 mM NaCl, pH 7.4) to the sample: 10 µL buffer per µL blood for dried spots (10 × volume) or 9 µL buffer per µL fresh blood (9 × volume). Incubate the mixture for 15 min at room temperature with gentle mixing.

steps.title: Incubate with dabsylated peptide
steps.instruction: Take the solution equivalent of 1 µL blood (after extraction) and add 1 nmol dabsylated bradykinin (DBK). Incubate the reaction at 37 °C for 60 min.

steps.title: Precipitate proteins
steps.instruction: Add ice‑cold acetone at six times the reaction volume (for capillary blood DBK assay: 60 µL acetone). Mix, then store the mixture at –20 °C for 1 h to precipitate proteins.

steps.title: Collect supernatant and dry
steps.instruction: Centrifuge briefly (or let settle), carefully remove the supernatant, and evaporate it to dryness (e.g., in a SpeedVac or under a gentle stream of nitrogen).

steps.title: Redissolve residue for TLC
steps.instruction: Dissolve the dry residue in 1 µL ethanol. Spot the entire solution onto a TLC plate. Rinse the sample vial with an additional 1 µL ethanol and add this rinse to the same spot on the plate.

steps.title: Develop TLC plate
steps.instruction: Develop the TLC plate in a mobile phase of chloroform : methanol : water : acetic acid (v/v/v/v) 11 : 4 : 0.6 : 0.09. Allow the solvent front to migrate, then remove and dry the plate.

steps.title: Scan and analyze TLC
steps.instruction: Scan the developed TLC plate (e.g., with a densitometer or scanner) and quantify the dabsylated fragments using JustTLC software (Sweday, Sodra Sandby, Sweden). Record fragment intensities for further data analysis.
